Frequently Asked Pricing Questions

Is the Free plan really free forever?

Yes! Our Free Forever plan has no trial countdown and requires no credit card. Small teams can manage up to 1,000 active leads and 5 team member accounts at zero cost forever.

Can I upgrade or downgrade between plans anytime?

Absolutely. You can upgrade from Free to Pro seamlessly with 1 click. If you need to switch billing cycles (e.g. from 6 Months to Yearly to save 33%), your account updates immediately.

What payment methods are supported?

We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), RuPay, Visa, Mastercard, and Net Banking through Razorpay's secure payment gateway. Enterprise clients can also opt for NEFT/RTGS bank transfer invoicing.

What happens if I reach the 1,000 lead limit on the Free plan?

We will never delete your data or lock you out. When approaching 1,000 leads, you can archive or export old leads to CSV, or upgrade to Pro to unlock up to 2,00,000 leads and unlimited team users.

Are there any hidden onboarding or migration fees?

None. What you see is what you pay. Standard cloud onboarding, CSV migration from Excel, and team training are completely free with your subscription.
